column4: train.sh's move gate (is_move_candidate) made any diff to scripts/checks/root_inventory.txt a legacy/ move needing an accepted acceptance rehearsal, so wip/decisions-followup, which only adds docs/proposals to the inventory, passed check (gates and review) and green CI and was still refused by land. Structural cause: one file carries two obligations, the P7 move rehearsal (top-level entries, legacy/) and the minimal-root inventory (first-level docs/ and scripts/ entries too), and the gate keyed on the file instead of on the move's own facts. Fixed on wip/fix-landing-machinery (c064cc7d): the gate compares the top-level entry set the inventory lists at base and head (comments, order and nested entries ignored); a legacy/ change or a non-tree legacy still triggers; root_inventory.sh is unchanged
column7: is_move_candidate triggers only on legacy/ changes, a non-tree legacy and a changed top-level entry set of the root inventory, with landing_script.sh controls (a docs/proposals inventory change needs no rehearsal; a new top-level entry and a legacy/ edit do); the trigger policy is approved by the owner and the change is on main

column4: Review failed open in the landing path: train.sh check set review=0 when no review command existed (no error), its review leg rejected only a published findings note (absent, malformed or blocked passed after a zero exit), and land read no review record at all, so a check run with --no-review landed like any other (facts-decision landed at ab537833d after train.sh check --no-review). Structural cause: review was enforced only as one leg's exit status inside check, a missing reviewer was mapped to a disabled leg, and land trusted CI alone: no reader of review provenance existed at land time. Fixed on wip/fix-landing-machinery (a173432e): check fails with no review command; review_provenance (verify.sh on origin's notes: a clean head note, or with no head note a clean note on every member at its exact SHA) gates both the review leg and land
column7: check fails without a review command; land refuses a train without review provenance; landing_script.sh controls show absent, malformed, blocked and findings notes, at the head or on a member, cannot qualify; the change is on main

column4: scripts/land/acceptance.sh's check leg ran train.sh check --no-review --no-remote, so an accepted rehearsal (the record the move gate trusts) could rest on a check that skipped review, and agents cannot run it (the permission system treats --no-review as a CI bypass); both its build leg and its broken-build control defaulted to make build, which the restarted root (no Makefile; nix develop --command lake build) does not have; its header described only --no-review and make build. Structural cause: the rehearsal scripted its own exemption from a required leg and copied the old tree's build entry point into two places, so it drifted when the root changed. Fixed on wip/fix-landing-machinery (9b48910f): check --no-remote with the review leg passing on verified notes; one BUILD_CMD default for both build legs; header corrected; a landing_script.sh structural control
column7: acceptance.sh runs check without --no-review, both build legs use one default (nix develop --command lake build), and the change is on main

column4: scripts/review/review.sh's prompts (standard and neutral) made any patch touching what an owner decision covers a finding, with no distinction between choosing a side and recording an answer the owner explicitly gave under docs/decisions.md's recording rule; the review leg refused the facts-decision recording batch, which then landed with check --no-review on a separate manual Codex ACCEPT. Structural cause: the prompt's owner-decision question had no notion of provenance, so a faithful recording had no path through the required review. Fixed on wip/fix-landing-machinery (39059429): recording an approved decision is permitted and the reviewer checks provenance (quoted, dated owner answer or rule), faithful transcription, scope and that nothing unapproved is added; choosing or revising an undecided question is still a finding; docs/REVIEW.md holds the rule, AGENTS.md and docs/LANDING.md link to it
column7: both prompts distinguish recording an approved decision from choosing one, docs/REVIEW.md is the single home of the rule, and the change is on main

column4: Sandboxes inherit the caller's git environment. scripts/checks/review_tool.sh isolated git config only, not the repository-locating variables; a pre-push hook of a LINKED worktree exports GIT_DIR=<repo>/.git/worktrees/<name>, so every git -C <sandbox> in the check acted on the caller. On 2026-11-06 `train.sh ci laudit` run from the linked worktree ~agent/audit-records made the hook's review_tool.sh create its test branches (nonff, capped, parse-*) and set core.bare=true in ~agent/audit-clone (kept unchanged as evidence), and push 28 commits to origin refs/notes/concrete-review (tip b4b364f4, pre-leak 5b6add0d) and 12 to refs/notes/concrete-review-findings (tip 21c56796, pre-leak fd3c6451), authored Review Gate, 17:16:49-17:17:43Z, annotating 22 sandbox commits that exist on no remote; no note was deleted or changed and every reader looks notes up by exact SHA, so none can count as provenance for a real commit. lambdaclass has no notes refs. Codex confirmed with a bounded reproducer on concrete-ci-2 at main f9a8c333 (caller refs and refs/notes/* changed: LEAK) and an independent GIT_DIR experiment. landing_script.sh and landing_bot.sh unset only five of git's local variables; legacy_frozen.sh, acceptance.sh, run-at-ref.sh and bot.sh unset none. Second incident, same cause: the first reproducer installed a pre-push hook that ran review_tool.sh; the leaked GIT_DIR made each nested push re-enter that hook, the recursion exhausted fede-256gb (load ~1900) and the OOM killer took down the orchestrator's session. Structural owner: the sandbox helper scripts/checks/lib/git_sandbox.sh (unsets every `git rev-parse --local-env-vars` variable), sourced by every repository-making script; reproducers and tests run with no installed hook, under timeout 120 and a 512-task / 8G bound
column7: every repository-making script under scripts/ sources git_sandbox.sh (scripts/checks/sandbox_isolation.sh, structural leg); review_tool.sh and legacy_frozen.sh run from a linked worktree with GIT_DIR exported leave the caller's refs, refs/notes/*, core.bare and upstream unchanged while a leaking control is detected (same check, bounded); train.sh and the pre-push hook refuse a linked worktree and train.sh refuses a clone without the repository hook; and the stray notes are removed from origin by a forward fast-forward notes commit whose before and after tips are recorded here
